Step 1 of 3 for registration. When system register_method is 'mobile' (default), send 'mobile', 'country_code', 'password', and 'password_confirmation'. If register_method is 'email', send 'email', 'password', and 'password_confirmation'.
Step 2 of 3 for registration (SMS/Email Verification). Requires 'user_id' returned from Step 1 and the verification 'code' sent to user's mobile/email.
Step 3 of 3 for registration (Profile Details & Referral). Requires 'user_id' and 'full_name' (min 3 chars). Optional 'referral_code'. Returns access token and user info upon completion.
Authenticates user account. 'username' can be either a mobile number (e.g. 1012345678) or an email address (e.g. user@example.com).
Request new password via SMS. Requires type='mobile', 'mobile' number, and 'country_code'.
Request password reset token via Email. Requires type='email' and user's 'email'.
Resets user password using the token sent to email. Token is passed in URL path.
Confirms verification code manually. Requires 'username' (mobile or email) and 'code'.
Redirects to Google OAuth authorization page.
Redirects to Facebook OAuth authorization page.
Social login callback for Google. Requires 'email'. Optional 'id' (Google Social ID) and 'name'.
Completes user profile during Google social registration. Requires 'email'. Optional 'name', 'mobile', and 'password'.
Social login callback for Facebook. Requires 'email', 'name', and 'id' (Facebook Social ID).
Logs out current user and invalidates JWT token. Requires Bearer Token header.
